| .op-popover: The float shadow token already draws the outline at the card weight, so the panel no longer adds a second 1px ring (which doubled the line in themes with a heavier outline).
| .op-dialog: The float shadow token already draws the outline at the card weight, so the dialog no longer adds a second 1px ring.
| .op-drawer: The float shadow token already draws the outline at the card weight, so the drawer no longer adds a second 1px ring.
| .op-surface--float: The float shadow token already draws the outline at the card weight, so the surface no longer adds a second 1px ring.
| .op-calpanel: The float shadow token already draws the outline at the card weight, so the panel no longer adds a second 1px ring.
| .op-cal-grid: The day grid has a fixed height equal to the month and year panels, so the calendar never changes height between its views.
| .op-cal-cells: The month and year panels have a fixed height equal to the day grid, so the calendar never changes height between its views.
| .op-cal-years: The year list scrolls inside the same fixed height as the other views.
| .op-cal-help: The help line keeps one line of height even when empty, so the calendar does not grow when a range is started.
| .op-table th: The line under the column titles is drawn at --stroke-card with the strong edge colour, so it matches the rim and the row separators in every theme (a heavier weight in themes that set the control outline above the hairline made it stand out).
| .op-chip: The ring is drawn at --stroke-card, the same weight as the outline of cards, panels and tables, so tags match the containers around them in every theme (1px by default). The default look is a solid fill in the tone colour with light text; the reference look (tint, outline, tone-coloured text) is the subtle variant.
| .op-stamp: The ring is drawn at --stroke-card, the same weight as the outline of cards, panels and tables, so stamps match the containers around them in every theme (1px by default). The default look is a solid fill in the tone colour with light text; the reference look (tint, outline, tone-coloured text) is the subtle variant.
| .op-notice: The ring uses --stroke-edge, the control outline weight, instead of a fixed 1.5px, so notices match inputs and buttons in every theme (1.5px by default). The pressed-in look comes from the shared --indent token.
| .op-grid: The outline is a ring drawn over the grid (a pseudo-element above the clipped content) at --stroke-card in the edge colour, so no fringe of the header tint shows between the ring and the clip at the rounded corners.
| .op-numfield--affix .op-numinput: The field is exactly as wide as its digits (the reference always left room for four), with the unit's own padding as the gap, so a unit reads next to the value like a word space.
| .op-stmt-top .op-amount: The amount now leads the top line at the start and the stamp sits at the end, so the amount is no longer pushed to the end and right-aligned.
| .op-stmt-top .op-amount-meta: The amount now leads the top line at the start, so its detail lines keep the default start alignment.
@media (max-width: 32rem) | .op-stmt-top: The amount and stamp no longer swap alignment on a narrow screen; the stamp loses its auto margin there instead.
The amount's detail lines keep the default start alignment at every width.
| .op-crumb, .op-crumb-current: The 48px minimum height made every breadcrumb row 48px tall for one line of text, so the trail floated far from the header above it. The row is the height of its text and each link keeps a 44px hit area through an ::after overlay.
| .op-day--today.op-day--mark: An empty rule in the reference (no declarations); nothing to port.
| .op-dialog::backdrop: Reka UI renders its own overlay element instead of a native dialog backdrop: .e-dialog-overlay carries the same background, fixed over the page.
| .op-drawer::backdrop: Same as the dialog: the Reka overlay element .e-dialog-overlay replaces the native ::backdrop.

Closing waits for the animation, which a transition would not allow. The other declarations of the rule are kept.

| .op-icon: Moved to .e-icon--glyph: fill and stroke apply only to the built-in filled glyphs, so icons from other sets (stroke icons such as Lucide) keep their own fill and stroke.
| .op-step-dot: The reference sets z-index: 1 on the dot so it sits over the connector line; the library uses the --e-z-raised token (value 1) because raw z-index numbers are not allowed. All other declarations of the rule are kept.
| .op-resizer: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings. The resizer sits inside its heading cell, which is its own stacking context, so z-raised is enough.
| .op-gridtable .op-sticky: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings. Sticky body cells use z-raised (the reference 2); the sticky header cell stays above them with z-sticky.
| .op-filterrow td: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings.
| .op-grid-empty: The reference uses !important to beat .op-table td. Without it the selector is .e-table td.e-grid-empty, which is more specific and has the same effect.
| .op-icongrid: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item .op-icon: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item span: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| :root: The washes and tokens now come from @eos-ui/tokens (defineTheme().css()), generated from tokens.json; the three color-mix washes are written there.
| .op-input:read-only:not(:disabled): A button also matches :read-only, so the tint landed on every Select trigger. The tint is now keyed on the readonly attribute: .e-input[readonly]:not(:disabled).
| .op-cal-grid td: The day cells keep 3px of room at each side so a selected day does not touch its neighbours or the edges of the grid.
| .op-appt-main: The facts are a child of the grid, so a narrow card can run them the full width under the photo: the column gap stays space-4 and the row gap is space-3. The first row is never shorter than the date tile.
| .op-appt-facts: The facts are a child of the grid, so the rows are spaced by the grid gap instead of a top margin.
| .op-appfooter: The side padding comes from the page column (.e-shell-inner) alone, so the footer text lines up with the header and the content instead of sitting inset by twice the gutter.
| .op-shell: The page area paints the page ground (--e-background) instead of the surface, so a theme can set the two apart.
